six_previous_blockers.mitigation: Header constructor overflow requires a size/range near SIZE_MAX. Matching Node source runtime vector<bool> uses: V8 wasm exported_tags sized by validated module tag count, and debug-only tracing nesting_stack push/pop. No remote JS/Wasm/module/compiler interface is exposed; MCP JSON is data only, body/output/node-count limits bound lengths. Wasm tag count is checked by consume_count against kV8MaxWasmTags=1,000,000 (also uint32_t), not size_t-near-maximum; debug push_back does not call the affected attacker-sized constructor. Full binary contains vector<bool> helper, so absence is NOT claimed.
six_previous_blockers.residual_risk: Adding eval/JS/Wasm execution, inspector access, native addons or attacker-selected native container sizes reopens review.
